description: Human-labelable operational intent taxonomy grounded in AppleSupport Twitter support corpus.

intents.name: software_update_and_os_compatibility
intents.definition: Customer inquiries regarding OS updates (iOS, macOS, watchOS), upgrade/downgrade procedures, update verification, or device software compatibility.
inclusion: Questions about installing, verifying, or troubleshooting iOS/macOS/watchOS updates.
Inquiries regarding device model compatibility with new OS versions (e.g. iOS 11 on iPhone 5s/6).
Questions about update download stalls, OTA verification errors, or reverting/downgrading OS.
exclusion: Battery drain after update (use battery_drain_and_charging_issues).
App crashes after update (use app_crash_freeze_and_performance_lag).
Wi-Fi disconnection after update (use network_and_connectivity_troubleshooting).
positive_examples: @AppleSupport Can I update my iPad Air to iOS 11 without losing any data?
@AppleSupport My iPhone 6 is stuck on verifying update screen for over 2 hours.
@AppleSupport Is it possible to downgrade from iOS 11 back to iOS 10.3.3?
negative_examples: @AppleSupport iOS 11 is draining my battery 20% every hour.
@AppleSupport Control center Wi-Fi button in iOS 11 doesn't turn off Wi-Fi.
boundary_cases: If customer mentions update failure + general slowness: classify as software_update_and_os_compatibility if the installation failed, otherwise app_crash_freeze_and_performance_lag if the update completed and the OS is slow.
intents.typical_support_behavior: Provide Apple Support compatibility documentation link; guide through iTunes recovery mode update or free up required storage space.

intents.name: battery_drain_and_charging_issues
intents.definition: Customer complaints and troubleshooting requests regarding rapid battery depletion, unexpected shutdowns, charging failures, or device overheating.
inclusion: Complaints about abnormal battery percentage drops or sudden shutdowns at 20-30% charge.
Device failing to charge, charging slowly, or showing 'Accessory Not Supported' with charging cables.
Device running unusually hot during normal charging or standby.
exclusion: Device physically swollen due to expanded battery (use hardware_damage_and_repair_service).
General performance lag without battery mention (use app_crash_freeze_and_performance_lag).
positive_examples: @AppleSupport My iPhone 7 battery was at 80% and died 5 minutes later.
@AppleSupport Why does my phone get extremely hot when plugged into the charger?
@AppleSupport Ever since updating, battery life went from all day to 3 hours.
negative_examples: @AppleSupport My phone screen popped open from battery swelling.
@AppleSupport Phone charges fine but YouTube keeps freezing.
boundary_cases: If customer says 'iOS 11 ruined my battery': classify as battery_drain_and_charging_issues (primary problem is battery, OS update is context).
intents.typical_support_behavior: Check Settings > Battery > Battery Usage by App; recommend toggling Background App Refresh; suggest hardware diagnostic.

intents.name: network_and_connectivity_troubleshooting
intents.definition: Customer issues regarding Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Cellular Data, Hotspot, GPS, or CarPlay connectivity.
inclusion: Wi-Fi failing to connect, dropping connection, or greyed out in Settings.
Bluetooth pairing failures with cars, AirPods, headphones, or other accessories.
Cellular 'No Service', 'Searching...', or mobile data disconnection issues.
exclusion: AirPods sound distortion or mute (use audio_music_and_accessory_issues).
iCloud sync delay over active internet (use storage_backup_and_icloud_sync).
positive_examples: @AppleSupport My iPhone X keeps disconnecting from my home Wi-Fi network every 10 minutes.
@AppleSupport Bluetooth won't pair with my car audio after the new update.
@AppleSupport My phone says No Service even though my carrier confirmed my account is active.
negative_examples: @AppleSupport My AirPods connect but the left ear has no sound.
@AppleSupport I have full Wi-Fi but App Store won't process my credit card.
boundary_cases: If Bluetooth connects but no audio plays: classify as network_and_connectivity_troubleshooting if pairing fails; audio_music_and_accessory_issues if pairing succeeds but sound output is corrupt.
intents.typical_support_behavior: Guide through Settings > General > Reset > Reset Network Settings; toggle Airplane Mode; reboot router.

intents.name: app_crash_freeze_and_performance_lag
intents.definition: Customer reports of third-party or native apps crashing, screen freezing, UI lag, keyboard typing stutter, or general system unresponsiveness.
inclusion: Specific apps closing unexpectedly on launch or during use.
Keyboard stuttering, typing delay, or touch responsiveness lag.
Device freezing on lock screen or requiring frequent force restarts.
exclusion: Physical display glass crack or digitizer hardware failure (use hardware_damage_and_repair_service).
OS update installation freeze (use software_update_and_os_compatibility).
positive_examples: @AppleSupport Every time I open the Camera app, the screen stays black and crashes.
@AppleSupport Typing has a 2 second delay on the keyboard in iOS 11.
@AppleSupport Instagram and Twitter keep quitting automatically when I open them.
negative_examples: @AppleSupport Screen shattered and touch no longer responds.
@AppleSupport iTunes won't let me purchase apps.
boundary_cases: If lag is accompanied by battery drain: choose battery_drain_and_charging_issues if battery is the primary focus, app_crash_freeze_and_performance_lag if sluggishness is the primary focus.
intents.typical_support_behavior: Force quit app, force restart device, update apps via App Store, reinstall troublesome app.

intents.name: apple_id_and_account_security
intents.definition: Customer issues regarding Apple ID credentials, account lockouts, two-factor authentication (2FA), verification codes, or password recovery.
inclusion: Forgotten Apple ID email or password.
'Apple ID has been locked for security reasons' or 'Account Disabled' prompts.
Unable to receive 2FA verification SMS or trusted device prompts.
exclusion: Device stuck on Activation Lock screen after factory reset (use activation_lock_and_device_security).
App Store subscription billing dispute (use billing_subscription_and_app_store_charges).
positive_examples: @AppleSupport I can't log into my Apple ID and the recovery email is old.
@AppleSupport My Apple ID is disabled for security reasons, how do I unlock it?
@AppleSupport Not getting my verification code on my trusted phone number.
negative_examples: @AppleSupport I bought a phone on eBay and it has the previous owner's iCloud lock.
@AppleSupport Apple charged me $9.99 for Apple Music without asking.
boundary_cases: Apple ID account lockout vs Activation Lock: If customer cannot sign in to Apple services on an unlocked device $\\rightarrow$ apple_id_and_account_security. If the device itself is locked out during setup $\\rightarrow$ activation_lock_and_device_security.
intents.typical_support_behavior: Direct to iforgot.apple.com; explain identity verification protocols; prompt private DM for security assistance.

intents.name: billing_subscription_and_app_store_charges
intents.definition: Customer inquiries, disputes, refund requests, or subscription cancellations regarding App Store, iTunes, or Apple Music payments.
inclusion: Unrecognized charges from Apple or iTunes on bank statement.
Requests to cancel recurring subscriptions or free trials.
Refund requests for accidental in-app purchases.
exclusion: Declined payment method due to invalid Apple ID credentials (use apple_id_and_account_security).
Hardware purchase refund at Apple Retail Store (use feedback_complaint_or_general_inquiry).
positive_examples: @AppleSupport I was charged $4.99 for an app subscription I cancelled last week.
@AppleSupport How do I get a refund for an accidental purchase my kid made on iPad?
@AppleSupport Getting an 'unknown error' when adding my credit card to App Store.
negative_examples: @AppleSupport I can't download apps because my Apple ID is locked.
@AppleSupport My paid apps keep crashing on launch.
boundary_cases: Payment decline due to Apple ID lockout: choose apple_id_and_account_security.
intents.typical_support_behavior: Direct to reportaproblem.apple.com; guide through Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions to cancel trial.

intents.name: storage_backup_and_icloud_sync
intents.definition: Customer issues regarding device storage capacity, iCloud storage management, iTunes backups/restores, and photo/data synchronization across Apple devices.
inclusion: 'iPhone Storage Full' or 'Cannot Take Photo' alerts.
iCloud backup failing to complete or taking too long.
Photos, Notes, or Contacts not syncing between iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
exclusion: Apple ID login authentication failure (use apple_id_and_account_security).
Local hardware flash memory failure (use hardware_damage_and_repair_service).
positive_examples: @AppleSupport System storage is taking up 45GB of my 64GB iPhone, how do I clean it?
@AppleSupport My iCloud backup says 'The last backup could not be completed'.
@AppleSupport My photos on my iPhone are not showing up in Photos on my MacBook.
negative_examples: @AppleSupport I can't sign in to iCloud because I forgot my password.
@AppleSupport My phone is slow after clearing storage.
boundary_cases: Storage full preventing iOS update: classify as storage_backup_and_icloud_sync if customer asks how to free up space; software_update_and_os_compatibility if the focus is on the update installation error.
intents.typical_support_behavior: Guide through Settings > General > iPhone Storage; explain iCloud Photo Library optimization; verify iCloud storage quota.

intents.name: hardware_damage_and_repair_service
intents.definition: Physical device damage, broken screens, liquid exposure, camera lens fractures, speaker/mic physical failure, or repair appointment requests.
inclusion: Cracked front glass, shattered back glass, or bent frame.
Device dropped in water or liquid contact indicator triggered.
Physical home button, Touch ID, Face ID, or volume rocker failure.
Requests to book an Apple Store Genius Bar appointment for repair.
exclusion: Software touch responsiveness lag without physical damage (use app_crash_freeze_and_performance_lag).
Battery draining quickly without physical swelling (use battery_drain_and_charging_issues).
positive_examples: @AppleSupport Dropped my iPhone 8 and the screen is completely cracked.
@AppleSupport Dropped my phone in the sink and now the speaker sounds muffled.
@AppleSupport How much does it cost to replace a broken home button at the Genius Bar?
negative_examples: @AppleSupport My screen works fine but keyboard is lagging.
@AppleSupport Battery percentage jumps around.
boundary_cases: Swollen battery causing screen to lift: classify as hardware_damage_and_repair_service (urgent physical safety hazard).
intents.typical_support_behavior: Explain warranty/AppleCare coverage limits; guide to locate.apple.com to book Genius Bar appointment.

intents.name: activation_lock_and_device_security
intents.definition: Customer issues regarding Activation Lock screen, Find My iPhone locking, proof of purchase removal, or lost/stolen device lockouts.
inclusion: Device locked to previous owner's iCloud account during setup.
Forgotten Activation Lock credentials on factory-reset device.
Putting device in Lost Mode or erasing stolen device via Find My iPhone.
exclusion: Regular Apple ID password reset on working device (use apple_id_and_account_security).
Hardware damage preventing Touch ID/Face ID recognition (use hardware_damage_and_repair_service).
positive_examples: @AppleSupport Bought an iPad on eBay and it's asking for the previous owner's Apple ID.
@AppleSupport I erased my old iPhone but now Activation Lock won't accept my credentials.
@AppleSupport My iPhone was stolen at the airport, how do I lock it remotely?
negative_examples: @AppleSupport I forgot my screen passcode and phone is disabled.
@AppleSupport I want to sign out of iCloud on my current phone.
boundary_cases: Screen passcode disabled vs Activation Lock: Screen passcode $\\rightarrow$ apple_id_and_account_security (iTunes restore). iCloud Activation Lock screen $\\rightarrow$ activation_lock_and_device_security.
intents.typical_support_behavior: Explain proof-of-purchase unlocking policy; direct to al-support.apple.com or original owner.

intents.name: audio_music_and_accessory_issues
intents.definition: Customer issues regarding sound playback, AirPods hardware/firmware, speaker volume, microphone input, Apple Music catalog, or Apple accessories.
inclusion: No sound from receiver/speaker, distorted audio, or static during calls.
AirPods microphone failure, audio cutting out, or charging case issues.
Apple Music playlist sync errors, missing offline downloads, or song playback errors.
exclusion: Bluetooth pairing connection failures (use network_and_connectivity_troubleshooting).
Apple Music subscription billing charges (use billing_subscription_and_app_store_charges).
positive_examples: @AppleSupport My right AirPod has no sound at all while the left one works fine.
@AppleSupport The earpiece speaker on my iPhone 7 is so quiet I can't hear calls.
@AppleSupport Apple Music deleted all my offline downloaded songs after update.
negative_examples: @AppleSupport AirPods won't connect to Bluetooth.
@AppleSupport I was charged twice for Apple Music.
boundary_cases: AirPods won't pair: network_and_connectivity_troubleshooting. AirPods paired but audio distorted: audio_music_and_accessory_issues.
intents.typical_support_behavior: Guide through resetting AirPods; check speaker mesh for obstruction; inspect Sound & Haptics settings.

intents.name: feedback_complaint_or_general_inquiry
intents.definition: Customer feedback, broad brand praise or complaints, retail store experience inquiries, or vague questions without a specific technical problem.
inclusion: General praise or complaints about Apple customer service or product quality.
Retail store hours, product availability, or general pre-sales inquiries.
Vague customer statements without a concrete troubleshootable defect.
exclusion: Any actionable technical defect covered by specific categories (e.g., battery, connectivity, OS update).
Account password resets or billing refund requests (use respective specific intents).
positive_examples: @AppleSupport Just want to shout out the team at the Regent Street Apple Store for great service!
@AppleSupport Apple products used to just work, now everything is buggy.
@AppleSupport When will iPhone X be available for in-store pickup?
negative_examples: @AppleSupport My phone is buggy because iOS 11 keeps crashing.
@AppleSupport My battery dies in 2 hours.
boundary_cases: Vague complaint: If the customer provides no actionable symptom, choose feedback_complaint_or_general_inquiry. If they mention a specific symptom (battery, crash, Wi-Fi), classify under that specific technical intent.
intents.typical_support_behavior: Acknowledge feedback with empathy; ask clarifying diagnostic questions if customer wishes to troubleshoot.
